name: Complete Room Booking Platform Documentation
description: Comprehensive technical documentation for a full-stack room booking and sharing platform built with Angular and Django. Explore the architecture, authentication, user management, room listings, search and filtering, bookings, notifications, receipts, and administrator dashboard.
headline: Angular & Django Room Booking Platform Documentation

software.name: Angular Django Room Booking Platform
software.description: A complete room booking and sharing platform built with Angular and Django, allowing guests to discover and book available rooms while homeowners can share and manage their own room listings.

features: Secure role-based user authentication and authorization.
Account management for guests, homeowners, and administrators.
Room listing creation and management for homeowners.
Restricted access allowing homeowners to manage only their own rooms.
Room search and discovery for guests.
Search filters to help guests quickly find suitable rooms.
Room booking functionality for available rooms.
Automatic booking confirmation after a successful reservation.
Notifications related to bookings and room activities.
Administrator dashboard with visibility into users, rooms, and bookings.
REST API communication between Angular and Django.
Secure access control and user data management.
